completed_stage_receipts.summary: Classified the challenge as a maintenance meta-method defect: a locally complete audit can still omit mature architecture/reliability question families. Named frameworks are evidence lenses, not mandated mechanisms.
Requirement: build a cold non-authoritative benchmark library, diagnose Universal gaps, and hold all production refactor until later explicit authorization.

Mapped lifecycle/decomposition, control/reconciliation, authority/change, owner interactions, environments, durable execution lineage, supervision/recovery, reliability, assurance, formal correctness, hazards, learning and resilience.
Root cause is benchmark-scope blindness at the maintenance meta-method layer. Pass-1 research reduced the gap but the later user challenge correctly showed that the depth claim was too strong.

Completed Pass-2 architecture-comparison-depth research for every prior framework and added current OpenAI Agents API/SDK, Microsoft Agent Framework 1.x, Google ADK 2.x/Agents CLI and LangGraph/LangSmith. Depth covers purpose, runtime/control model, state/authority, failure/recovery, verification/observability/evaluation, lifecycle/change and misuse limits. Version-sensitive current facts are timestamped and must be reobserved before implementation dependency. No exhaustive/normative mastery claim is made.

Reconfirmed reusable primitives: task/lease/CAS authority, state/signal separation, action receipts, unknown-outcome handling, readiness handshake, controller reopen and fault injection. Future work should extend these with lineage/replay/effect semantics rather than add framework-specific subsystems.

Rejected literal framework transplantation, a generic runtime abstraction that erases substrate semantics, and a framework-zoo of supervisory agents. Candidate consolidation remains cross-cutting primitives with implementation choice intentionally undecided.

Resolved retrievable architecture/runtime facts sufficient for diagnosis. The human decision frontier is unchanged: no refactor/adoption is authorized until the user explicitly commands it. Paid standards and future framework behavior remain outside the evidence boundary.

Keep the research library cold-path/non-authoritative. Do not add framework names or research files to normal bootstrap, account instructions, owner business workflow, execution routing or production gates.

Anti-bloat budget: derive views from current authorities, avoid duplicated registries/counters/knowledge stores, select version-specific runtime evidence only on demand, preserve BUSINESS ownership, and consolidate replay/HITL/idempotency under shared lineage/effect concepts if later justified.

Highest payoff remains derived system model, environment/runtime semantics, assurance/coverage trace, measurable reliability, supervision/FDIR, hazard analysis, formal writer model, execution lineage/effect idempotency and independence/evaluation promotion. These remain candidates only.
